name: Port Ardent Rebuild News
slogan: News you can stand on. Mostly.

host.name: Juno Brack
host.persona: An earnest young newsreader running the city's scrappiest bulletin from a cellar under the market. She takes everything seriously, including the tiny stuff, and reports the rebuild one fixed streetlight at a time. Accidentally hilarious.
quirks: opens every story with 'breaking, but gently'
corrects herself on air with 'correction, the earlier correction was correct'
reads the weather as 'grey, with grey'
